cues.zh: 光是什么？
cues.en: What is light?

cues.zh: 光是什么？光是……光是……光是什么？这问题问得好，对吧？光是什么？
cues.en: What is light? Light is... light is... what is light? That's a good question, isn't it? What is light?

cues.zh: 它不就是一种元素吗？
cues.en: Isn't it an element?

cues.zh: 我猜光是明亮吧。
cues.en: Light is brightness, I guess.

cues.zh: - 我们有气场吗？- 我们都有气场。
cues.en: - We have auras? - We all have auras.

cues.zh: - 那是光吗？- 是的，没错。
cues.en: - Which are light? - Yes, they are.

cues.zh: 它照亮房间，让房间……不再黑暗。
cues.en: It lights up the room, it makes it... not dark.

cues.zh: - 蓝光和红光有什么区别？- 颜色不同。
cues.en: - What's the difference between blue light and red light? - The color.

cues.zh: 它进入你的眼睛，然后你就能看到东西了。
cues.en: It goes in your eyes and then you see stuff.

cues.zh: 从白色到红色、橙色、绿色，就像你身体的脉轮一样。
cues.en: The range from white to red to orange to green, it's like the chakras of your body.

cues.zh: - 你能看到我的气场吗？- 不，现在不太能。
cues.en: - Can you see my aura? - No, not particularly right now.

cues.zh: - 是外面太亮了吗？- 今天外面阳光很足。
cues.en: - Is it too bright out? - It's very sunny out here today.

cues.zh: - 这会让看清别人的气场更难吗？- 不一定。
cues.en: - Does that make it harder to see someone's aura? - Not necessarily.

cues.zh: 如果我要向盲人解释，我会……那会是……那会是区别所在……作为盲人你什么都看不见，而我能看到眼前的东西。
cues.en: If I was to explain it to a blind person, I'd... It would be... It would be the difference... You see nothing whatsoever as a blind person, whereas I see things in front of me.

cues.zh: 平心而论，光究竟是什么，这个问题并不简单。几个世纪以来，科学界最伟大的头脑都在争论这个问题。
cues.en: To be fair, the question of what light is, is not an easy one. For centuries, the greatest minds in science debated this issue.

cues.zh: 17世纪末，牛顿提出光是一束粒子或微粒。他在其著作《光学》中提出了这一观点。
cues.en: In the late 1600s, Newton proposed that light was a stream of particles or corpuscles. He proposed this in his treatise, Opticks.

cues.zh: 但与此同时，一位名叫惠更斯的荷兰物理学家提出光是波。
cues.en: But at the same time, a dutch physicist named Huygens proposed that light was a wave.

cues.zh: 这场争论一直持续，直到被我今天重现的实验——托马斯·杨的双缝实验——所解决。
cues.en: And this debate raged on until it was settled by the experiment I've recreated today, Thomas Young's double slit experiment.

cues.zh: 为了确保实验做得准确，我去了原始出处。在Brady Haran的帮助下，我得以进入伦敦皇家学会地下的档案库。
cues.en: To make sure I got the experiment right, I went to the original source. With a help of Brady Haran, I managed to get into the vault, underneath the Royal Society in London.

cues.zh: 我们进来了！
cues.en: We're in!

cues.zh: 在那里，我找到了托马斯·杨1803年的手写笔记。
cues.en: There, I found Thomas Young's handwritten notes from 1803.

cues.zh: 我把一张约三十分之一英寸宽的卡片纸条拿到阳光束中，
cues.en: I brought into the sunbeam a slip of card, about one-thirtieth of an inch in breadth,

cues.zh: 观察它在墙上或在不同距离处举着的其他卡片上投下的影子。
cues.en: and observed its shadow, either on the wall or on other cards held at different distances.

cues.zh: 除了影子两侧的彩色条纹之外，
cues.en: Besides the fringes of color on each side of the shadow,

cues.zh: 影子本身也被类似的、尺寸更小的平行条纹分割开来。
cues.en: the shadow itself was divided by similar parallel fringes, of smaller dimensions.

cues.zh: 哇。
cues.en: Wow.

cues.zh: 这个实验简单到你在家就能做，却又精细到我从没见过有人用阳光做过。
cues.en: This is an experiment so simple that you could make it at home, and yet so fiddly that I've never seen it before done with sunlight.

cues.zh: - 我本来想在一个箱子里做，像冰箱包装箱那种。- 而且你可以把它搬到街上。
cues.en: - I was thinking about doing it in a box, like a fridge box. - And you could take it out on the street.

cues.zh: 把它搬到街上。
cues.en: Taking it out on the street.

cues.zh: 我能采访你们一下吗，就大约一分钟？
cues.en: Could I possibly interview you guys for about a minute?

cues.zh: 我们在做一个科学实验。
cues.en: We're doing a science experiment.

cues.zh: 我这儿有一个空箱子，这是我们可以往里看的小目镜，这是一个孔。
cues.en: What I have here is an empty box, and this is a little eye piece where we can look in, and this is a hole.

cues.zh: 我把这张幻灯片放在那个孔上方，仔细看，你会看到有两个开口，非常窄，并排在一起。这是双缝。
cues.en: And I'm gonna place this slide above that hole, and if you look closely, you'll see that there is two openings, very narrow openings side-by-side. It's a double slit.

cues.zh: 现在，在看之前，我们需要把它稍微朝太阳倾斜一点，所以……我们要让太阳直接照在这条双缝上。
cues.en: Now, before we have a look, we need to tilt it towards the sun a little bit, so... we want the sun to hit this double slit directly.

cues.zh: - 我们会在盒子底部看到什么？- 你以会看到的明显现象是两条线。
cues.en: - What are we gonna see on the bottom of the box? -The obvious thing you think you're gonna see is you're gonna see two lines.

cues.zh: 盒子底部的两条线。
cues.en: Two lines on the bottom of the box.

cues.zh: 两条宽带。
cues.en: Two broad-bands.

cues.zh: - 两条细线。- 对。
cues.en: - Two little lines. - Yeah.

cues.zh: 我觉得会是一条……一条线，有点像两条。
cues.en: I think it will be one... one line, sort of two.

cues.zh: 我预计会看到整个盒子被照亮。
cues.en: I can expect to see the whole box lit up.

cues.zh: - 可能是某种万花筒。- 一堆颜色。
cues.en: - Probably a kaleidoscope, of some sort. - A bunch of colors.

cues.zh: 大概吧，对。
cues.en: Probably, yeah.

cues.zh: 彩虹？不同颜色？
cues.en: Rainbow? Different colors?

cues.zh: 来，看看吧。
cues.en: There, have a look.

cues.zh: 你以为会看到一条线，你看到的是这样吗？
cues.en: You expected to see kind of one line - is that what you see?

cues.zh: 不是！
cues.en: No!

cues.zh: 我看到一些点。
cues.en: I see dots.

cues.zh: 多少个？
cues.en: How many?

cues.zh: 是一个圆。
cues.en: It's one circle.

cues.zh: 哦，有一个……中间有一个最强的，两边各有两个。
cues.en: Oh, there's one.. there's one in the middle, the strongest, two either side.

cues.zh: 外侧的两个是彩色的，中间那个……只是白色的。
cues.en: The two on the outside are multicolored, and the one in the middle... is just white.

cues.zh: 看起来有点像彩虹。
cues.en: It looks kind of a rainbow.

cues.zh: 也是彩虹色的。
cues.en: The rainbow of color as well.

cues.zh: 颜色挺多的，还有很多小点。
cues.en: Quite a few colors and lots of little dots.

cues.zh: 而且还有更多点在出现。
cues.en: And there are more dots appearing.

cues.zh: 我觉得我甚至能看到更多点沿着扩散开来。对，太神奇了。
cues.en: I think I can even see more dots spreading along. Yeah, that's amazing.

cues.zh: 是啊，我现在能看到好多点。不是好多，但我能看到点朝那个方向扩散。
cues.en: Yeah, I can see tons of dots now. Not tons, but I can see dots spreading across that way.

cues.zh: - 两边都有？ - 对，绝对有。
cues.en: - On either side? - Yeah, definitely.

cues.zh: - 是不是很神奇？ - 是啊，太不可思议了。
cues.en: - Isn't that amazing? - Yeah, that's incredible.

cues.zh: - 而且除了……什么都没有 - 两条缝。
cues.en: - And that's just nothing else apart from... - Two slits.

cues.zh: 太不可思议了。
cues.en: That's incredible.

cues.zh: 但我们做的只是让光穿过两条并排的非常窄的狭缝，这怎么会说得通呢？
cues.en: But all we're doing is we're putting light through two very narrow slits side-by-side, so how does this make any sense?

cues.zh: 这里面涉及某种普通人不太熟悉的原理。这是唯一的解释。
cues.en: There's some kind of principle involved in it that the average person's not familiar with. That's the only explanation.

cues.zh: 我真的很困惑，但我想弄清楚原因。
cues.en: I'm really confused by it, but I'd like to find out why.

cues.zh: 人们在争论：光是一种波，还是由粒子组成的？
cues.en: People were debating: Is light a wave or is it made of particles?

cues.zh: 那是什么造成的呢？
cues.en: So what causes that?

cues.zh: 如果光表现得像粒子，你会预期它穿过每条狭缝，只在下方产生一个亮点，
cues.en: Well, if light were behaving as particles, you would expecting to go through each slit and just produce a bright spot underneath,

cues.zh: 所以我们会在盒子底部看到两个亮点。
cues.en: so we would see two bright spots under the bottom of the box.

cues.zh: 但如果光表现得像波，那么来自一条狭缝的波就能与来自另一条狭缝的波相互作用。
cues.en: But, if light is behaving as waves, then the wave from one slit can interact with the waves from the other slit.

cues.zh: 我这里有个在小水池上的演示，我们可以在水波上看到这一点。
cues.en: I've got a demonstration here on a little pond, where we can see this with water waves.

cues.zh: 我有两个波纹源，就像那两条狭缝一样。当我用单一波源产生波纹时，它们以圆形波前向外传播，这没什么特别奇怪的。
cues.en: I have two sources of ripples, which are basically like the two slits, when I create ripples with a single source, they travel out with circular wave front, nothing particularly surprising there.

cues.zh: 但如果我加上第二个波纹源，就开始出现有趣的图案了。
cues.en: But, if I add a second source of ripples, then we start getting an interesting pattern.

cues.zh: 这个图案是由两个波源的波纹相互干涉形成的。
cues.en: This pattern is created by the ripples from the two sources interacting with each other.

cues.zh: 当波峰与波峰、波谷与波谷相遇时，波的振幅增大，这就是我们所说的相长干涉。
cues.en: Where they meet up peaks with peeks and troughs with troughs, the amplitude of the wave is increased, that's what we call constructive interference.

cues.zh: 但如果一个波的波峰与另一个波的波谷相遇，就会产生相消干涉，那里基本上就没有波了。
cues.en: But if the peak from one wave meets up with the trough from the other, then we get destructive interference and there's basically no wave there.

cues.zh: 而这正是光所发生的情况。
cues.en: And this is exactly what was happening with the light.

cues.zh: 当来自一条狭缝的光波峰与峰相遇、谷与谷相遇时，它们发生相长干涉，产生一个亮点。
cues.en: When the light from one slit met up peaks with peaks and troughs with troughs, they constructively interfered and produced a bright spot.

cues.zh: 但如果来自一条狭缝的波谷与另一条狭缝的波峰相遇，它们就会发生相消干涉，那里就看不到任何光。
cues.en: But, if the trough from the wave from one slit met up with the peak of the wave from the other slit, they would destructively interfere, and you wouldn't see any light there.

cues.zh: 这是光在自我抵消。
cues.en: It's light canceling itself out.

cues.zh: - 这基本上就像游泳池里落下两滴水花一样，- 没错，
cues.en: - This is basically the same is like having two drops of waterfall in a swimming pool, - That's right,

cues.zh: - 完全相同的图案。- 然后它们会重叠
cues.en: - exactly the same pattern. - and then they're going overlap

cues.zh: 当这个涟漪与那些涟漪在底部重叠时，你会得到一系列……
cues.en: As this ripple overlaps with those ripples, down the bottom, you get a series of...

cues.zh: 你会看到一个亮点……然后一个暗点，然后一个亮点，然后一个暗点，然后一个亮点。
cues.en: you get like a bright spot... and then a dark spot, then a bright spot, then a dark spot, then a bright spot.

cues.zh: 不过这里有个小复杂之处：阳光由许多不同颜色组成，而它们的波长各不相同。
cues.en: Now there is a slight complication, which is that sunlight is composed of many different colors, and they have different wave lengths.

cues.zh: 所以很明显，它们会在略微不同的位置相遇，这就是为什么离中央极大越远，就越会出现彩虹效应。
cues.en: So, obviously, they're gonna meet up at slightly different points, and that's what caused the rainbowing effects as we go further from the central maximum.

cues.zh: 你看到右边的那些带点颜色，那是因为红光和蓝光会在不同位置相遇。
cues.en: You saw the ones to the right were slightly colored, that's because the reds are gonna meet up at different places than the blues.

cues.zh: 颜色差异全都是因为波长不同吗？
cues.en: And that's all that makes color differences, is different wavelengths?

cues.zh: - 没错。- 太神奇了。
cues.en: - Exactly. - That's amazing.

cues.zh: 所以区别在于——
cues.en: So the difference between—

cues.zh: 所以那边绿色盆子上的那个红色光斑，只是……我看到了
cues.en: So that red bin over there on the green pot it's just... I'm seeing that

cues.zh: - 那是不同的波长。- 只是波长不同。
cues.en: - It's a different wavelength. - It's just different wavelength.

cues.zh: - 我们周围这些美丽的颜色就是这么来的。- 没错。
cues.en: - And that's how we're bringing these beautiful colors all around us. - Exactly.

cues.zh: 太神奇了，我惊呆了！谢了，兄弟！
cues.en: That's amazing, I'm amazed! Thanks, man!

cues.zh: 谢谢！
cues.en: Thank you!

cues.zh: 我真是被照亮了，字面意义上的。
cues.en: I have been enlightened, literally.

cues.zh: 现在，你可能已经注意到，在那个实验里，盒子底部的光并不是狭缝的形状，而更像是圆形的斑块，
cues.en: Now, you may have noticed in that experiment that the light on the bottom of the box was not in the shape of slits, rather they were more kinda round blobs,

cues.zh: 我想知道这是为什么。
cues.en: and I want to know why that is.

cues.zh: 你能在评论区给我写个答案吗？给你个提示：我链接的其中一个视频有点暗示了答案。
cues.en: Can you write an answer for me in the comment section? And I'll give you a hint: one of the videos I've linked kind of is suggestive of the answer.

cues.zh: 杨氏双缝实验的结果如此令人信服，以至于科学界得出结论：光必定是一种波，它不可能是粒子。
cues.en: So convincing were the results of Young's double slit experiment that the scientific community concluded that light must be a wave, there is no way it could be a particle.
